title: Tower evaluation pairing
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $a:X\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use ordinary module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, with completed coefficient sheaf $R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ for $W=X,s$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $F_n=Ra_{!,n}$ for compact support using one fixed compactification $a=pj$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], $G_n=Ra_n^!$ for the finite constructible comparison-class exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and $\omega_n=G_n(A_n)_s$. Fix a strict complex $Q_\bullet$ of $(A_n)_X$-modules with quotient-semilinear transitions, representing a normalized dualizing tower [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]: $Q_n$ represents $\omega_n$, and its transitions are adjoint to the counit-defined comparisons $\omega_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\cong\omega_n$ of [lem-coef-finite-dualizing]. Let $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $K_n=K\otimes^L_{R_X}(A_n)_X$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and suppose its reductions have Tor amplitude in one finite interval $[a_0,b_0]$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $C_n=\Gamma(s,F_nK_n)$ and $C=\Gamma(s,Ra_!K)$, with coefficient-point sections [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Use the quotient ring tower sites $\mathcal Q_W$, separately derived compact support $F^{\mathcal Q}$, and object $B_\omega$ specified in [lem-coef-tower-trace-rectification]. Define $\mathsf K_\bullet=(\operatorname{const}K)\otimes^L_{R_X^{\mathrm{const}}}\mathcal Q_X$; a K-flat representative $P\to K$ gives the strict representative $(P\otimes_{R_X}(A_n)_X)_n$ with quotient transitions [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Let $B_K=R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}(s,F^{\mathcal Q}\mathsf K_\bullet)$, with restriction to the constant base ring $R$. This is point sections of the specified compact-support reduction tower [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor], including its transition maps. Define $\mathsf H(K)$ by applying the termwise global Hom complex from a representative of $K$ to a K-injective tower resolution of $\operatorname{Res}Q_\bullet$, over $R_X$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] [lem-weil-tower-evaluation-kinjective]. These constructions give functors on the derived input category, with $\mathsf H$ contravariant and $B$ covariant. Their evaluations are
$$\operatorname{ev}_n\mathsf H(K)\cong\mathbf R\operatorname{Hom}_{R_X}(K,\operatorname{Res}_n\omega_n)\cong\mathbf R\operatorname{Hom}_{X,A_n}(K_n,\omega_n),\qquad\operatorname{ev}_n B_K\cong C_n.$$
There is a morphism in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R)))$
$$\beta_K:\mathsf H(K)\otimes_R^L B_K\longrightarrow B_\omega.$$
Its evaluation at $n$ is the ambient compact-support projection morphism followed by evaluation, with target $\Gamma(s,F_n\omega_n)$; no trace is included. For every $f:K\to K'$ it satisfies the dinaturality identity
$$\beta_K\circ(\mathsf H(f)\otimes1)=\beta_{K'}\circ(1\otimes B(f))$$
on $\mathsf H(K')\otimes_R^LB_K$. The pairing is the derived tower-site scalar-adjunction/evaluation composite using the ambient projection morphisms [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]; their invertibility is not required.
